verdicts.reason: Both put the 'How It Works' CTA at the top, above the headline, which breaks the reading order. Both cut the decorative circle off from the suitcase and leave it in the top-right corner, where it crowds the Meridian logo and touches the end of the headline. Both shrink the legal text to an unreadable size and leave a large empty band above it. A keeps a more comfortable 42px left margin, but its suitcase sits slightly right of centre. B's 25px margin is cramped against the canvas edge, though its suitcase is centred. They are otherwise almost identical, so A wins by a small margin.
